technical-summary: The stored-manifest execution projection now reduces the live heat histogram path (a per-start run-directory file) to recorded-or-not, exactly as the stored-plan key does, so a second start of the same config in the same installed prefix replays its stored plan instead of refusing with BC_CFG_PLAN_MISMATCH and re-carrying the measurement. Test added first: a different run-directory histogram path replays, turning the recording off still refuses.
user-summary-candidate: Restarting a named serving config on the same install now reuses its stored plan instead of rewriting it each start.
